note: Static export (dynamic=False) required. An initial dynamic=True export silently dropped mAP50 to 0.677 (an 11% relative loss) despite per-image detection counts matching on a 10-image spot check -- the aggregate mAP swept across confidence thresholds exposed a real degradation the spot check missed. Static export resolves it: both ONNX variants retain ~99% of PyTorch accuracy.
